---
title: "Map Explorer"
page-layout: full
---

Click a point to see the site and its sampled species. Use the layer control to switch base maps.

```{r}
library(leaflet)
sites <- read.csv("data/sites.csv")
leaflet(sites, height = 600) |>
  addProviderTiles("Esri.OceanBasemap", group = "Ocean") |>
  addTiles(group = "Streets") |>
  addCircleMarkers(~lon, ~lat, radius = ~sqrt(catch_t) * 2,
                   color = "#0b4f6c", fillOpacity = 0.6,
                   popup = ~paste0("<b>", site, "</b><br>Main species: ", main_species,
                                   "<br>Catch: ", catch_t, " t")) |>
  addLayersControl(baseGroups = c("Ocean", "Streets"))
```
